r01.style: Cinematic still from a 2000s American prescription-drug television commercial, black and white, desaturated, melancholy, soft diffused lighting, gentle depth of field, shot on 35mm film, photorealistic. The same woman appears: early 40s, straight black hair in a low bun, denim shirt.
